audit.whatIsWrong: ALL SEVEN stages are wrong on both layers. Charts read Ziggs/Skill/Gnar/Gnar/Ziggs/Gnar/Gnar; the packet says Skill,Gnar,Skill,Skill,Gnar,Skill,Ziggs, and every one of the seven whys[] entries states the packet's verdict.
audit.why: whys[0] ends 'the stage is mixed' (Skill, marked Ziggs). whys[1] describes a free chunk (Gnar, marked Skill). whys[2] ends 'a coin-flip' and whys[3] 'live and die on your Rage bar' (both Skill, both marked Gnar). whys[4] says a Mega combo 'kills an escape-less Ziggs in a single window' — that is a Gnar stage and the page marks it ZIGGS at 3/10, telling the reader to avoid the exact window that spikes[1] calls a one-combo kill. whys[5] ends 'keeping the all-in even' (Skill, marked Gnar). whys[6] opens 'Full-build artillery out-scales you' (Ziggs, marked Gnar). Not one row survives.
audit.corrected: Skill / Gnar / Skill / Skill / Gnar / Skill / Ziggs as one atomic group across both layers, ratings rebuilt to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike was inverted — the full layer rated it 3/10 to Ziggs while the content layer calls it a one-combo kill for Gnar — and the full-layer first-item spike said 'Stridebreaker' with no Ziggs timing.
audit.why: Level 6 is Gnar's single best window in this lane: Crunch closes on a champion with no dash, Wallop stuns, GNAR! flings him into a wall. Ziggs' real spikes are Satchel Charge at 20s (his only escape) and his two-item artillery build. Mega Inferno Bomb is 120s at rank 1 and is a wave/siege tool here, not a duel threat.
audit.corrected: phases[4] flipped to Gnar at 8/10 with the combo stated, and the cooldown block now dates Satchel, Q, E and R.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: the full layer never names any Ziggs ability mechanically and never gives Satchel Charge's cooldown, despite instructing the reader to 'engage when it's down' in six separate strings. Short Fuse is never mentioned at all.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1 and only 12s at rank 5, at 1000 range — that number is the entire lane plan, because it is both his knockback on your Crunch AND his only escape. Bouncing Bomb at 850 range on 6s is why the poke war is unwinnable. Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s slow zone, which is what actually cuts off the Hop escape the page tells you to rely on. And Short Fuse periodically empowers his next auto with its cooldown reduced by every ability cast — the flagged burst tell.
audit.corrected: All four named with real cooldowns and ranges, and the Short Fuse tell added.

edits.before: Boomerang + hop kite wins every melee matchup early. Identify how Ziggs contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Bouncing Bomb out-ranges Mini autos at 850 range, but he cannot punish you for safe last-hitting — call the stage mixed.

edits.before: Rage management is the champion — track your own bar. Only take the trade when Ziggs's Satchel Charge is down.
edits.after: Your level-2 Hyper speed proc plus the Boomerang slow walks a dashless Ziggs down for a free chunk of HP.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Ziggs must walk into your range.
edits.after: He pokes from range but owns no dash and no point-and-click CC, so this stage is a coin-flip on Rage timing.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Satchel Charge's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: These levels live and die on your Rage bar: Mega up and you all-in through his immobility, Mega down and you eat free bombs.

edits.before: Mega + R against a wall is the best engage top lane owns. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ziggs's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: With Mega available, Crunch into Wallop-stun into a GNAR! wall-combo kills an escape-less Ziggs inside a single window.

edits.before: Stridebreaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Satchel Charge's cooldown.
edits.after: Mega form plus your first item baits the Satchel knockback and stuns him out of kited bombs.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Ziggs carry threat 7.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Full-build artillery out-scales you: Liandry's plus bomb range sieges you from screens away, out of Mega's reach.

edits.before: Weather the poke — kite him mini and Mega-stun the Satchel Charge cooldown. Gnar wins the Satchel Charge cooldown windows.
edits.after: Weather the poke in Mini, then bait Satchel Charge: it is 20s at rank 1, and without it Ziggs owns no dash at all.

edits.before: Kite him mini and Mega-stun the Satchel Charge cooldown. Track Satchel Charge before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Kite in Mini, bait the Satchel knockback, then Crunch in and Wallop-stun him. It is 20s at rank 1, and he has no dash.

edits.before: Ziggs wins by landing Satchel Charge, denying your pattern, and kiting you off the wave.
edits.after: Ziggs wins by out-ranging you with an 850 Bouncing Bomb and sieging from artillery range.

edits.before: His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1 and it is his only escape — bait it out before you ever leap.

edits.before: Ziggs wastes Satchel Charge — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Bouncing Bomb is 6s at rank 1 — Hop the telegraph, don't tank it.

edits.before: That is Ziggs's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Short Fuse empowers his next auto, and every ability he casts speeds it up.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Satchel knocks you back mid-leap — spend it first, then Crunch in.

edits.before: Getting caught at zero rage right after Mega ends — that 15-second window is when Gnars die.
edits.after: Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s and slows you — that is what cuts off your Hop escape.

edits.before: Track Ziggs's Satchel Charge: His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Boomerang kite into Mega slam.
edits.after: Satchel Charge (W, 20s, 1000) knocks you back and is his only escape. Bouncing Bomb (Q, 6s) out-ranges your Boomerang at 850.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Satchel Charge (W): 20s at rank 1, 12s at rank 5, 1000 range — his only escape, and it knocks your leap away. Bait it first. - Bouncing Bomb (Q): 6s, 850 range. - Hexplosive Minefield (E): a flat 16s slow zone. - Mega Inferno Bomb: 120s.

notes: Every single level-chart row was wrong here — seven of seven on both layers, the worst in the slice. The most damaging one was level 6: the full layer rated it 3/10 to Ziggs and told the reader to reassess the all-in, while the content layer's own spikes[1] calls the exact same window a one-combo kill (Crunch, Wallop-stun, GNAR! into a wall, on a champion with no dash). A Gnar player following the chart would skip his single best window in the matchup. Packet defect (never names Ziggs's abilities) fixed with real numbers throughout: Satchel 20s/12s at 1000, Bouncing Bomb 6s at 850, Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16s, Mega Inferno Bomb 120s. Content layer was already accurate and correctly named; only its win[] enums were wrong. DERIVED FLAG IGNORED: the kit puts a 'percentHealth' flag on Satchel Charge, which would make it punish HP stacking and would justify the missingInteractions 'resistances-invalidated' headline. Riot's description says only that it deals magic damage and knocks enemies away, with no percent-health component. Per the description-beats-flag rule I asserted nothing about it, so that one flagged interaction is deliberately not on the page.
unverified: Whether Satchel Charge deals percent max health — derived flag says yes, Riot's description does not mention it. Not asserted.
